title: Golden Energy Boy Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a young male character with spiky blond hair wearing a black and gold armored outfit, demonstrating powers with glowing golden energy effects. From left to right: creating an energy orb, lifting a large dripping golden sphere above his head, explosively releasing energy forward, and standing with residual golden bubbles and sparks around his body.
prompt: A young male character with spiky blond hair and determined expression wearing black tactical outfit with gold armor plates on shoulders, knees and gloves, shown in four distinct action poses against a dark background. He manipulates bright golden yellow energy magic, creating swirling orbs, holding a large dripping golden sphere above his head, unleashing an explosive forward energy blast with particle effects and splatter, and finally standing with fading golden bubbles and sparks around his fists and body.
